name: Energy drink
description: Carbonated caffeine and sugar with added taurine and B vitamins.

tcm.note: A modern product with no classical entry; stimulant and drying, read as hot.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna by its caffeine load.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; outside the classical record entirely.

histamine.note: The one drink SIGHI annotates with the compound: theobromine inhibits DAO. That is the mechanism people wrongly attribute to caffeine.

stimulant.note: High-dose caffeine with sugar and additives. SIGHI singles this category out for theobromine's effect on DAO.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
